fact: UNDP reports that on 5 June 2024 it launched a tender for a firm to build the exchange platform for litigants, lawyers and the judiciary, with online filing of requests and complaints, document deposit, notifications and online payment of fines, and that the Ministry's server room was rehabilitated.
title: Projet d'Appui au Renforcement des Institutions de la Chaine Pénale 2024: Principales réalisations
